Use case: stylized-concept. Asset type: Vandrheim RPG general UI GOLD CURRENCY icon, for prices, shops and HUD counters.
Create ONE standalone gold coin icon.
Reference 1 is the STYLE reference: match its warm brass gold, simple flat shaded bevel, bold clean dark charcoal outline, illustrated UI finish and excellent tiny-size readability. Reference 2 is the existing currency IDENTITY reference: preserve its central Nordic sun emblem, but simplify it heavily to match reference 1. Do not copy the photoreal granular texture or intricate knotwork of reference 2.
Subject: one thick round gold coin in an almost frontal view with a slight three-quarter tilt so a narrow lower-right side edge is visible. A broad polished raised rim, a darker ochre inset round face, and one large embossed Nordic sun symbol in lighter warm gold at the center: round central boss and eight short bold rays. The emblem must look like stamped metal relief, not writing or a hole. Use very few clean readable shapes and one restrained edge highlight. Warm brass #C89445, golden highlights, darker ochre shading, charcoal #292A2E external contour. Attractive fantasy-game currency, cohesive with the current micromenu and close icon. A softly faceted illustrated bevel is enough; avoid realistic rendering or ornate inventory artwork.
Centered on a square canvas, the complete coin fills 80–82% with even clear margins. GENUINELY TRANSPARENT background and crisp alpha edges. Clearly recognizable as gold money at 16–32 pixels. No background, tile, button frame, floating sparkle, aura, particle, cast shadow, text, numbers, currency letters, dollar sign, crown, skull, stacked coins, purse, weapon, extra props, intricate rim knotwork or tiny decorations. Only one coin.
